title: Pure change-and-take-back: core/ui/undo.js with node tests
change: New pure module from the forms2 design (same repo, MIT; source noted in both headers): changesOf(before, after) lists the exact changes (rows by id, fields by path, meta skipped); takeBack(draft, changes) puts back only what still holds the value the change wrote, a removed row only if no row with its id is back, an added row only if unchanged since; returns {done, kept}. tools/check.mjs adds it to the purity list.

title: The engine: the browser's checks speak our words at the box, with no grey bubble
change: In dom.js, installed once at import when a real document exists (data-forms-kit on <html>): a capture 'invalid' listener that cancels the bubble, draws validityWords under the box (.field-error[data-kit], aria-invalid, aria-describedby), and for the first box of the pass clears the old line inside steady(), brings the field under the top bar (reveal start, visualViewport aware, dispatching window 'planner:reveal') and focuses it with preventScroll inside the tap's event; boxes in novalidate forms are left alone. Silent checkValidity (depth counter wrapping HTMLInput/Select/TextArea/Form .checkValidity). Finger-down hold: from pointerdown to that gesture's click (or 400 ms after pointerup, or pointercancel) words are only noted. Leaving words on capture focusout for boxes holding something unusable, drawn with steady(the newly focused box). Words go on the next input/change that makes the box valid. ui.fieldError(box, words) for a page's own one-box refusal. base.css form block: .field-error, [aria-invalid=true] red edge, .field boxes scroll-margin-top 40px. CONVENTIONS: checkValidity is silent, reportValidity and a held submit speak.

title: Boxes the kit reads itself: '1,200' and '5%' taken, impossible figures stopped, phone and email keyboards
change: ui.numberBox({name, value, min, max, whole, percent, required, missing}) used by ui.form for type number and percent: a text box with inputmode decimal and data-kind, read by readNumber; a percent box shows '%' inside (.unit-in, .unit) with placeholder 'e.g. 7'. The kit's own words (boxWords) live in the box's validity via setCustomValidity, set on input before page listeners and re-asserted at the capture click of a submit button, clearing only words the kit set. Leaving a box and the start of a submit write the plain number back ('5,000' -> '5000', '7%' -> '7'). readForm divides a percent by 100 to 12 significant digits. moneyBox: default ceiling under a billion when no max (max: null lifts it), words with the plan's sign. Date: min defaults to 1900-01-01, max 'today' token. type tel/email: type, inputmode, autocomplete, email autocapitalize off and spellcheck false. Field option 'missing' (data-missing). whole: true or a step of 1 or more refuses fractions; other steps are hints.

title: Return goes to the next box a person types in; only the last box saves
change: In a kit form, Return in a one-line box (text, number, money, percent, date, tel, email) moves to the next typeable box (one-line or notes) and is stopped there; in the last one the browser's implicit submit runs (and the engine with it). Choice lists and tick boxes are skipped. enterKeyHint 'next'/'done' set at build and again on focusin. A box in no form inside #content: a bubble-phase keydown on document (a page's own Enter runs first): unusable value -> reportValidity(); else the next box of the same card; else blur(). Search boxes skipped.

title: A keyboard open puts the cursor in a new form; Cancel returns to the row only when the app knows the row
change: One capture click listener notes the control activated inside #content (words, keyboard or not via click.detail === 0, data-key row, rowNote of its list up to 300 rows, identities of kit forms already on the page), forgotten at the end of the task. A ui.form built during that click is opened by it only if its identity (submit words + section heading + first label) was not there before, first such form only; opened from the keyboard its first control gets the cursor; a touch focuses nothing; ui.form(..., {opener}) to name it. Cancel runs onCancel, then finds the opener: same node; else the one control with the same words in the one row with the same data-key; else the same place in a list whose rows read the same (sameRowIndex); else nothing; found -> reveal center when not wholly on screen, focus with preventScroll. A Save brings nothing back by itself. ui.openUnder(row, build) returns close(): holder li/tr/div.rec-form after the row, reveal of row-to-first-box with nearest, keyboard open focuses the first box, close() removes the holder and focuses the opener. base.css: .rec-form, .records li.rec-form.
